verdict.rationale: An uptime SLA and a public status page are fair questions for a SaaS work-management product like Asana, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no mention of a published uptime SLA, an uptime commitment, or a public incident status page. The 'status updates' docs cover project status updates inside Asana, which is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know the vendor's published uptime SLA and can check real-time incident status via a public status page
